The best B2B lead generation companies in 2026 fall into two models. Appointment-setting agencies run outreach for you and hand over booked meetings. Outbound automation agencies build the data, enrichment and sending system, run it with you, and leave you owning it. Both can fill a calendar. They differ on who owns the data, how cost scales, and what happens when the contract ends.

This guide compares 9 B2B lead generation agencies across cold email, phone, LinkedIn and outsourced SDR models, with published pricing where it exists, Clutch review counts, and a framework to pick the right lead generation agency for your offer.

Disclosure: ManasFlow wrote this guide and ranks itself first. We put ourselves at #1 because we build and run the outbound system (Clay enrichment, Instantly and HeyReach sequencing, CRM logging) and you keep it, which suits teams that want outbound as a long-term channel. If you want booked meetings without owning any system, phone-heavy outreach or a large outsourced SDR team, one of the other companies below fits better, and we say which.
Best B2B lead generation companies: a brief overview
ManasFlow: Best overall for automation-first teams: we build and run the Clay, Instantly and HeyReach outbound system, signal-triggered and logged in your CRM.
Belkins: Best for a full multichannel appointment-setting program, with the most Clutch reviews in this list.
Callbox: Best for global and APAC campaigns, multilingual outreach and event lead generation.
CIENCE: Best for scalable outsourced SDR teams with published per-SDR pricing.
Martal Group: Best for tech and SaaS firms that want onshore SDRs in North America and Europe.
Cleverly: Best for SMBs that want low-cost, LinkedIn-first outreach.
SalesBread: Best for small B2B service firms selling on LinkedIn with manual personalization.
MarketJoy: Best for intent-data-driven campaigns in manufacturing and industrial niches.
Operatix: Best for B2B software vendors expanding across EMEA, LATAM and APAC.

Source: Clutch profile pages, checked 2026-10-21. Operatix reviews sit under the memoryBlue profile. SalesBread's profile could not be loaded and ManasFlow has no Clutch reviews, so neither is plotted.
1. ManasFlow, best overall B2B lead generation agency for automation-first teams

ManasFlow is an outbound automation agency: we build and run the Instantly, HeyReach and Clay system that generates your pipeline, and you own every domain, list and workflow. Accounts are picked on buying signals (job changes, funding, hiring, website visits), enriched and verified in Clay, contacted with the signal as the first line, and every reply is logged in your CRM.

We run the same stack on our own pipeline (Instantly, HeyReach, Attio, Unipile and n8n), so the system you get is one we operate every week. On our site we publish client work such as Earleads, where website visitor signals now flow straight into outbound targeting with no manual work.

2. Belkins, best for full multichannel appointment setting

Belkins, founded in 2017, runs appointment setting across cold email, cold and intent-based calling, LinkedIn, SMS, WhatsApp and paid ads, plus outsourced SDRs, ABM, deliverability consulting and HubSpot work. It has the largest review base in this list at 234 Clutch reviews and reports $2B+ in revenue generated for clients since 2017 (self-reported).
Its plans are monthly retainers with yearly appointment minimums of 30+, 100+ and 200+ depending on tier.
Mid-market and enterprise teams that want a full program run for them
Monthly retainer plans; dollar figures not published
Belkins says first appointments arrive within about 30 days of a 14-day launch
3. Callbox, best for global and multilingual campaigns

Callbox, founded in 2004, runs multichannel lead generation and appointment setting by phone, email, LinkedIn, chat, webinars and events, with teams in the US, UK, Australia, Singapore, Malaysia, Hong Kong and Colombia. It reports 15,000+ companies served across 60+ countries and now uses AI voice agents alongside human SDRs.
Companies selling across APAC or many countries at once
Built for mid-market and enterprise budgets
4. CIENCE, best for scalable outsourced SDR teams

CIENCE provides outsourced SDR teams for outbound and inbound follow-up across phone, email and LinkedIn, plus B2B contact data, ads and demand generation. It is based in Miami and reports 2,500+ clients.

Its pricing page is the most detailed in this list: a $2,000 per month campaign team, a $499 per month platform fee, SDRs from $1,750 per month offshore or $3,500 per month in the US or EU, a performance bonus and a one-time setup fee, all month to month.
Companies that want to add SDR capacity quickly and scale it up or down
SDRs from $1,750 per month offshore, $3,500 per month US or EU
Performance bonus and setup fee on top
Performance bonuses make total monthly cost harder to predict
5. Martal Group, best for onshore SDRs in tech and SaaS

Martal Group, in business since 2009, provides outsourced sales teams for cold email, LinkedIn and calling, plus appointment setting, ABM and an AI SDR platform. It has 200+ onshore sales executives across North America, Europe and Latin America, with offices in Oakville, San Francisco, Uniondale (New York) and Clermont-Ferrand, France.
Onshore SDRs in North America and the EU
Tech and SaaS companies selling into North America and Europe
Onshore reps with local market knowledge
Outsourced model, so the playbook stays with the agency
6. Cleverly, best for low-cost LinkedIn-first outreach
Cleverly, based in Los Angeles, runs LinkedIn lead generation, cold email, cold calling, appointment setting and outsourced SDRs. It has 85 Clutch reviews.
Its Clutch profile lists a $1,000+ minimum project size, and reviewer-reported engagements range from $2,800 to under $10,000.
SMBs and agencies testing outbound on a small budget
Clutch's review summary notes concerns about lead quality
Its own site cites both 1,000 active clients and 5,000+ clients
7. SalesBread, best for LinkedIn outreach with manual personalization

SalesBread runs done-for-you LinkedIn and email outreach where every message is personalized by hand rather than by AI, and leads are delivered daily. It requires the client to have LinkedIn Sales Navigator and does not run calling, ads or content.
Its service page lists pricing at 2,000 to 3,000 per month, month to month, and the homepage offers a money-back guarantee.
Manually personalized LinkedIn and email outreach
Small B2B and service firms selling on LinkedIn
2,000 to 3,000 per month, month to month
LinkedIn and email only, no calling
Waitlist of several weeks to start

8. MarketJoy, best for intent-data campaigns in industrial niches

MarketJoy, based in Pensacola, Florida, runs email and phone outreach, list building, appointment setting and outbound SDRs, backed by its own data product, InfoJoy, which it says holds 310M+ B2B profiles. It goes live in 15 business days, charges no setup fees and offers what it calls a 100% SQL guarantee.
Manufacturing and industrial companies with long sales cycles
Also sells SEO services, so it is less specialized
9. Operatix, best for software vendors expanding internationally

Operatix, which now trades under the memoryBlue name, provides outsourced SDRs exclusively for B2B software vendors across North America, EMEA, LATAM and APAC. It says its 300+ SDRs sell in 22 languages from offices in London, California, Texas and Singapore.
SaaS and software vendors entering new regions
